chapters.label: Qatar, live
chapters.text: World Cup semi-final, 2022. Morocco kept crossing, and Ibrahima Konaté kept clearing. This is how he did it. Hakim Ziyech curls one to the near post. Konaté attacks it, jumps, and heads it away. Cleared!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Konaté reads the curl early. He steps across, in front of Youssef En-Nesyri, and takes off first. Forehead through the ball, and it flies high and wide.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: His signature: the powerful headed clearance. Attack the ball at its highest point. Use your forehead. Head it high and wide, away from danger!
